pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygonal patches with sharp, jagged edges. High angularity at vertex points. Patches on the flank exhibit significant spatial variation in size and complex, star-like geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological web of light-colored interstitial space. Junction nodes are predominantly three-way intersections. Thickness of the pathways is narrow and consistent across the flank, with some tapering at acute patch corners.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, high-frequency serration along the neck mane. The silhouette exhibits low-amplitude jaggedness consistent with individual hair tufts visible against the sky.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear, light-colored cicatrices or scratch marks are visible on the posterior flank and hindquarter, cutting across the dark patch pigments.
other_distinctive_markers: An oxpecker bird is perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck, creating a distinct localized silhouette anomaly.
